class.name: OcgAISLine
class.brief_description: Constructs line datums to be used in construction of composite shapes.
class.description: ! Constructs line datums to be used in construction of ! composite shapes.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Provides a new color setting aColor for the line in the drawing tool, or "Drawer".

method.name: SetWidth
method.description: Provides the new width setting aValue for the line in the drawing tool, or "Drawer".

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Removes the color setting and returns the original color.

method.name: UnsetWidth
method.description: Removes the width setting and returns the original width.
